Name: The Bloody Rose's Farm
Author: hoshikuzunosora
Description:
What it says on the tin!

All grass is tillable because uhhh I said so /lh.

Other features include:

- The lamps are functional, providing a nice bit of light along the pathways

- Forest Farm Forage spawns. Because why not.

- Bits of blue grass littered throughout the west side of the farm! There is no truly dedicated "ranching area" this time, allowing for more freedom to decorate as people see fit.

-Two big plots of land to farm in, along with some smaller plots in front of the house.

[color=#ff7700][size=5][b]REQUIREMENTS:

[/b][/size][/color]- Content Patcher

- DaisyNiko's Tilesheets

- HXW Tilesheets

Thank you for visiting my mod! I hope you have a nice day/night.

Downloads.Description: Main release. Unzip into your mod's folder to install!
